title: Invalid JSON messages triggers an unhandled exception in JsonWebsocketConsumer and AsyncJsonWebsocketConsumer
author: JulienPalard
body_preview: Hi!  On malformed json sent by clients to `JsonWebsocketConsumer` or `AsyncJsonWebsocketConsumer`, a `JSONDecodeError` is raised and left unhandled.  The unhandled exception stops the django process (which will be restarted by Daphne so that's OKish). title: Decide on the future of the collapsing list component
author: adamzap
body_preview: Before I refactor [the JavaScript for the collapsing list component](https://github.com/django/djangoproject.com/blob/main/djangoproject/static/js/mod/list-collapsing.js), I want to make sure we that we still want to use it on the site.
